in the blink of an eye, instantly

to try doing (auxiliary: V-て + みる)
explanatory/softening sentence ending; implies 'and so...' or trails off for a request/lead-in

resultant state of a deliberate action (V-て + ある = it has been done/arranged)
sentence-final particle expressing assertion or slight impatience (casual male speech)

vocabulary.meaning: departing at ~, departure (suffix for transport schedules)
bound for ~, heading to ~ (suffix for destinations)

that much, so much, to that degree

to do something like ~, to do the sort of thing that ~

is not present, does not exist here (polite negative of いる)

vocabulary.meaning: to state conclusively, to say with certainty, to assert definitively
to tell the truth, to be honest
to verify, to confirm, to check
had been doing ~, but... (contraction of 〜ていたんですが; explanatory + trailing 'but')

even (emphatic particle, stronger than も: 'not even')
to arise, to occur; here: to feel the urge/inclination

just finished ~ing (indicates an action just completed)
